comparison_prohibitions: Do not generalize voluntary consultation response percentages to every EU27 creator; per-question response samples may differ.
Do not pool professional studio-space access question with the full consultation population.
Do not use the study to estimate typical YouTube first-year income, zero earner rate or individual net profit.
Do not interpret 70% international watch time as 70% unique persons living abroad or international earnings share.
Oxford Economics impact GDP and FTE modeled outputs are not creator salary, native payouts, median net income or respondent counts.
Question responses about recommendation algorithms are self-reported perceived dependence, not randomized algorithm-outage causal effects.
EU27 region must not be renamed 'all Europe'; survey coverage of non-EU European countries is not established.
